findings.title: BuildIndex no longer serializes builds of the same key
findings.body: BuildIndex used to hold cacheMu for the whole build, which also prevented two callers from indexing the same NamespacedResource at once. The lock is now taken only to insert the finished index. getOrCreateIndex is still check-then-act (GetIndex nil, then build), and init runs builds with an errgroup, so two builds of one key can overlap. The later insert overwrites the cache: the discarded index may already have watch updates applied, and the winner is a stale snapshot, so search silently misses writes. For file indexes, a second bleve.New on the same directory can also fail or corrupt the on-disk index. Per-key singleflight (or a lock held from the nil check through cache insert) is required; a shorter global lock alone does not fix the lost-update window.

findings.title: Startup watch starts at latest RV and drops events written during index build
findings.body: init lists each namespace via build(), which returns the resource version observed by that list, then ignores it. Only after every namespace has been indexed does it call WatchWriteEvents, which records listLatestRVs at that later moment and polls strictly after those versions. Any write committed after a namespace's list snapshot and before the watch baseline (other storage-server replicas, or the main Grafana process writing the same DB while this process is still starting) is neither in the built index nor replayed. Moving this work into NewResourceServer makes that window the entire startup index build. The watch must resume from the RV returned by each build, not from the RV at the end of all builds.

findings.title: Index init goroutines race on shared err and counter
findings.body: The errgroup workers in init all assign the outer err from build() and increment totalBatchesIndexed with no synchronization. With WorkerThreads > 1 (the concurrency this change is trying to use), that is a data race: a worker can return another worker's nil and hide a failed namespace build, so Init succeeds while that index was never built. The span attribute namespaced_indexed is also racy. Each worker needs its own error variable, and the counter needs atomic increment or a post-Wait tally.

findings.title: TotalDocs ranges the index cache without cacheMu
findings.body: TotalDocs iterates b.cache with no lock. search.init now starts the watch goroutine and then immediately calls TotalDocs for the new startup log. That goroutine can handle a write for a namespace that was not prebuilt and call BuildIndex, which writes b.cache under cacheMu. Concurrent map iteration and write panics the process during startup. TotalDocs must take cacheMu.RLock (and BuildIndex must keep the write lock around the map update).
